description.value:
You summon forth an intangible field of thousands of tiny control rods to absorb ambient radiation. These rods hover in the air all around you but are too small to affect sight lines or otherwise interfere with targeting. All allies within the area gain resistance 5 to damage from radiation effects and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against poison and radiation effects.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Cosmic Radiation Rods]

Heightened (+3) The status bonus increases by 1, and the resistance increases by 5.
